intro: Ogunaro Wolfrunner is the Horde's premier wolf breeder and kennel keeper in Orgrimmar, stationed by the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor. He tends the fierce wolves chosen to bear orc champions and their trusted allies into battle. For seasoned riders seeking a bond with Durotar's apex predators, Ogunaro is the master to see.

p: Situated near the Hunter's Hall within the Valley of Honor, Ogunaro Wolfrunner oversees the breeding and conditioning of Orgrimmar's battle wolves. The bond between orc and wolf dates back generations across the plains of Draenor and the rugged wilderness of Durotar, representing a partnership of mutual respect rather than mere domestication. Ogunaro ensures only the hardiest, fiercest beasts—from dire wolves to agile timber prowlers—are entrusted to warriors who have proven their strength and worth to the warchief.
